context: 04_chars_missing: the 120pt gap cap is NOT the main cause of anchored text boxes. The page-local latch ctx.positioned (DocxWriter 3126-3144) multiplies one anchored line into every later line on the page: 655 lines / 24,920 chars vs the cap's 1,469. Measured: -Dp2w.pagepos=0 -Dp2w.anchorkeep=0 cuts 69_two_col_legal 36 boxes/1358c -> 9/367, academic-paper 51/2942 -> 3/181, 323_credit_card 13/222 -> 6/35, 311_fir 3/206 -> 1/30, and changes NOTHING on 47 other 04-failing docs. Adding -Dp2w.zganchor=false: 69 -> 7/242, 323 -> 4/26. No combination reaches 0 boxes, so 04 does not flip. Separately: 47 of the 64 04-failing documents carry FEWER THAN 200 boxed characters - their box is a stamp, not body text, so emptying boxes cannot clean them. A spendWideGap foot-band patch was applied, rebuilt and is a no-op on 69/323/311; reverted.
